title: UnitCon: Synthesizing Targeted Unit Tests for Java Runtime Exceptions
datasets: Bears 14 + Genesis 16 + NPEX 59 + VFix 29 + Defects4J 80 = 198 targeted runtime-exception cases; separate RQ2 scan of 51 open-source repos for Infer NPE alarms.
task: Targeted unit-test generation for specific Java runtime-exception locations; static-analysis-guided enumerative synthesis
input_setting: Program + target exception location; Infer error conditions/method summaries guide test synthesis
concept_hook: Sufficient failure conditions + search pruning; support for concept-directed synthesis.
limitation: No LLM; 80 Defects4J targeted runtime-exception cases, not all-purpose bug-reproduction benchmark. Authors report 512GB RAM, 188GB storage, very long full run.
